# Usage: LLM agents — read this file to navigate the compiled wiki before querying individual pages.

## What is this?
B2B-Commerce is a Medusa v2 + Next.js 15 B2B e-commerce platform.
This wiki is compiled from raw source code via the Karpathy llm-docs pattern.
All pages have frontmatter (title, description, tags, source_refs, last_compiled).
Use page descriptions to pick which file(s) to read for a given question.

## How to query
Instead of reading raw apps/ or infra/ source code, read the compiled wiki page for your topic.
Each page cites its source_refs — use those to trace back to the code if you need line-level detail.

## Quick Answer Guide (for LLM agents)

Q: What modules exist in the B2B backend?
A: Read docs/content/modules/index.md

Q: How does quote negotiation work?
A: Read docs/content/modules/quote-module.md (state machine + sequence diagram)

Q: How does the approval gate work / what is hasPendingApprovals?
A: Read docs/content/modules/approval-module.md

Q: How is observability deployed locally?
A: Read docs/content/infrastructure/observability-stack.md

Q: Why is there a separate bootstrap Terraform module?
A: Read docs/content/infrastructure/local-first-iac.md (bootstrap anti-deadlock) + docs/content/infrastructure/terraform-bootstrap.md

Q: What AWS resources exist today vs. at v0.3?
A: Read docs/content/infrastructure/terraform-modules.md (module inventory table)

Q: What is the spending limit reset frequency on Company?
A: Read docs/content/modules/company-module.md (Company model table, spending_limit_reset_frequency field)
